**In celebration of Super Group Cares, DigiOutreach was proud to support[The Homestead](https://homestead.org.za/) , a Cape Town based nonprofit organization dedicated to helping vulnerable individuals rebuild their lives and create pathways to a safer, more stable future. The organization has been providing support, care, and development programs in local communities since 1982.**


The Homestead delivers a range of prevention, outreach, residential care, and reintegration programs designed to promote well-being, education, independence, and long-term opportunities for those facing significant life challenges.


As part of our Super Group Cares launch, DigiOutreach donated R110, 000 to support the valuable work undertaken by The Homestead. This include:


- Essential hygiene and personal care items
- Daily necessities that support program participants and care teams
- Practical resources that help create safe and supportive environments


DigiOutreach is proud to support an organization that works every day to restore dignity, strengthen resilience, and create opportunities for a brighter future. Through this contribution, we hope to help The Homestead continue its important work in building stronger, more inclusive communities.
